headline: Mexico Stocks Suffer Steepest Drop Since June on Peso Slide
summary: Mexico's benchmark stock index fell 1.75% as the peso slid 2.3% and mining shares tumbled amid concerns over US interest rates.
why: Emerging market equities and currencies are highly sensitive to shifts in US monetary policy expectations and global commodity prices, which directly impact capital flows in Latin America.

impacts.name: S&P/BMV IPC
impacts.why: Foreign capital outflows and falling mining stocks dragged down the domestic benchmark index.
